Specification: An implementation in PlusCal of the lexicographically-least circular substring algorithm from Booth (1980). Computes a failure function f and an offset k such that the rotation of b at offset k is lexicographically minimal, with TypeInvariant and Correctness operators stating the desired property.
IfThenElse: IF j < 2 * n THEN pc' = "L5" ELSE pc' = "Done"
IF b[j % n] /= b[(k + i + 1) % n] /\ i /= nil THEN pc' = "L7" ELSE pc' = "L10"
IF b[j % n] < b[(k + i + 1) % n] THEN pc' = "L8" ELSE pc' = "L9"
IF b[j % n] /= b[(k + i + 1) % n] /\ i = nil THEN pc' = "L11" ELSE pc' = "L14"
IF b[j % n] < b[(k + i + 1) % n] THEN pc' = "L12" ELSE pc' = "L13"

DivisionNotes: All Lx labels (L3..L14, LVR) are PlusCal-translated actions with primed pc/state -> ActionDefNames.
Terminating, Next are also actions; Init is the initial-state predicate.
TypeInvariant, IsLeastMinimalRotation, Correctness are state predicates over current state.
Spec and Termination are temporal properties.
Corpus, nil, vars are pure value definitions.
TemporalNesting=false: only [][Next]_vars and <>(pc="Done"), no nested temporal operators.
VerificationTools is TLC because the module is a PlusCal-translated algorithm without TLAPS proofs.
